text:
Yes, switch. Your first pick is right 1/3 of the time, and the host's reveal doesn't change that, so the other closed door holds the car the remaining 2/3 of the time.

This assumes the standard rules: the host knows where the car is, always opens a goat door you didn't pick, and always offers the switch. If the host opens a door at random and it happens to show a goat, switching is only 50/50. If the host offers the switch only selectively (say, only when you picked the car), switching can be worse.
